test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 10 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
The given sentence is divided into four segments. Select the option that has the segment with a grammatical error.

When I saw / her, she write / a poem / with full attention.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The primary issue in the sentence is the incorrect verb form "**write**."
 
• The correct past tense form should be "**was writing**" to maintain consistency with the past tense "When I saw".
 
• Thus, the error is located in **part 2** of the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"When I saw her, she was writing a poem with full attention."*
